content: Nuunii odeez baazaypp waannay yheya. Salo Ubbapp Afa Xooss zufaanaypp ushachch bagga betteez yhay garkk qeese halaqay nuus yeza.
E oothizay tuma dunkkaane maaqqeez geeshsha aqo, ye dunkkanat tukintteezana as kusher baazin Goday kushera.
Qeese halaqa ubbay muxaatasinnee yarshsho yarshshodayis shuuminttiza. Yeyi gishos, yha qeesay yarshshodayis pettibazii yezodayis koshshiza.
Higge kiitizay garkk yarshshiza qeesitay yez gishos Kiristtoosa sa7a yeza baz maaqqeezako qeese baaya.
Unttii qeesetith oothiza dunkkaanay salo yezayis aazisonnee eesho. Muse dunkkaana essiza wode Xooss eeko, «Taanii nena derell afa beezeez aazisa kaallii naaginttor oothoba» yeegeeza.
Yhatti maaqqiko Yesuusa gancce gelii dabbothiza qaala caaqay, tiina qaala caaqaypp aadhizay gishos E ekkeez oosay unttiisaypp aadhiza. Yeyi eqqeezay aadhiz ufayis qaalayida.
Tiina qaala caaqayid boro baa maaqqeezako nam7inth qaala caaqo koshshooya.
Zini Goday eza borii, yhaygarkk yeegeeza:

content.text: oroth qaala caaqo caaqqiza wode ye7oda.
Ye qaala caaqay ta u aditay Gibxxe biittapp kushe aykkii,
goochchii kesseez wode unttar caaqqeez caaqay garkk baaya.
Goday unttii ta caaqayid ammaninttekkazay gishos
ta caaqqod caaqay yhaya yeegiza Goday.
Taanii ta higga u kahayid gaddoda;
Unttapp oonkka fa shoora woy fa isha,

content: Xoossii yha caaqa «Orothi qaala caaqo» guussay tiinaasa cima maheeza. Yikkee, cimayinnee ceegay dhabiza wode helleeza.
